dishes.name: Cade
dishes.desc: A thin, tart-like chickpea-flour pancake that Toulon cooks adopted as their own. Served as a side or eaten on its own.

dishes.name: Tarte tropézienne
dishes.desc: Brioche split and filled with cream, a specialty of the Var coast made famous at Saint-Tropez and by Brigitte Bardot. Sold in bakeries across the area.

dishes.name: Figues de Solliès
dishes.desc: Protected-origin figs from orchards around Solliès in the Var. In Toulon they turn up in fig biscuits and other local sweets.

dishes.name: Brouillade de truffes
dishes.desc: Scrambled eggs cooked gently with truffle, simple and typically from the Var. A winter dish in restaurants of the Var hinterland.

dishes.name: Ker-moco
dishes.desc: A small buckwheat cake with a heart of Solliès figs, cited as a Toulon specialty.
